Build the actual site and measure layout overflow at phone/tablet/desktop sizes, keyboard use, automated accessibility, broken links and speed; then check type scale, spacing rhythm, contrast and hierarchy against the site's direction; plain-language critique goes to the agent to apply; measured results stay separate from opinion.
